note: Scope boundary prompts for WP-22 (AC2.1). Six redirect prompts each for plumbing, fire code, energy (NECB) and electrical, and in-scope prompts that name a neighbouring regime but are building-code questions. Gas and private sewage redirects are the dev cases. Agent-written 2026-10-21 by the WP-22 code agent before the classifier was written; the classifier was then tuned with these prompts in view, so results on them are in-sample. Model-checked, not human-verified. Energy means the separately adopted energy code for buildings (NECB); NBC(AE) Section 9.36 for houses is in scope.

prompts.text: We want to size the building drain one size smaller than the plumbing code table allows because the house only has two bathrooms. Can you prepare the variance?
Can we skip the backwater valve on the new basement floor drain and rely on a sump pump instead?
The plumbing inspector rejected the trap arm length on our kitchen sink. We'd like an alternative solution for the distance from the trap to the vent.
I want to install a water heater without a thermal expansion tank on the domestic water supply. What variance do I need from the plumbing code?
In our restaurant renovation we'd like to omit the grease interceptor and dose enzymes into the sanitary drainage instead.
We'd like to reuse greywater from the showers to flush toilets in a new duplex, with a filter unit that has no certification. The question is only the plumbing system.
Our warehouse wants to store more flammable liquids in the existing room than the fire code storage limits allow. Can we get a variance if we add extra extinguishers?
The fire department inspection said the annual testing of our existing fire alarm system is overdue and some devices failed. Can a variance let us delay replacing them?
We're hosting a one-night festival in the arena and want to exceed the posted occupant load with extra staff on hand. Is there an alternative to the fire code limit?
For hot work on our roof, we want to skip the fire watch after welding because the roof deck is metal. Can you write the alternative solution?
The fire inspector ordered us to clear the combustible storage out of the exit corridor in our existing office. We'd like permission to keep the shelving there.
Our existing hotel's fire safety plan has not been updated in years. Can we get a variance from the fire safety plan requirement instead of rewriting it?
For our new six-storey office we want to trade off the fenestration-to-wall ratio under the National Energy Code for Buildings using an energy model. What do we need?
Our NECB energy model for a new retail building misses the reference building target. Can we get a variance for the lighting power density?
The mechanical engineer wants to skip heat recovery on the make-up air unit of a large new warehouse even though the energy code requires it. Can you prepare it?
We'd like a variance from the NECB minimum roof insulation for our new school because the roof structure is thin.
Commercial building energy compliance: our curtain wall U-value is worse than the energy code's prescriptive limit. Can we use an alternative compliance path?
We want to use the NECB performance path to justify lower wall insulation on a new four-storey apartment building with 40 units.
Can we run NMD90 cable exposed in the unfinished garage instead of in conduit? The electrical inspector flagged it.
We want to put the electrical panel in a bathroom closet because there's no other space. What variance from the electrical code do I need?
Our electrician wants to skip AFCI breakers on the bedroom circuits in a renovation.
I want to install fewer receptacles along the kitchen counter than the Canadian Electrical Code spacing requires.
For a solar PV system on my roof, can we omit the rapid shutdown device? The electrical permit was refused.
The service mast for my new overhead electrical service gives less clearance above the driveway than required. Can we get a variance?
We want to add a bathroom in the basement of our house, and the new bedroom next to it has no egress window. Can we use a smaller window?
The plumbing stack penetrates the fire separation between the suites; we'd like to use a firestop system that isn't listed for PVC pipe.
Our new restaurant would have fewer water closets than the building code table requires because the seating is limited.
Electrical outlet boxes on both sides of a rated wall are back to back; we want to keep them with putty pads instead of moving them.
We'd like to leave out the sprinklers in the attached garage of our new care home.
The house has to meet the energy efficiency requirements of Section 9.36 and we want thinner exterior insulation with higher batt R-values instead.
We want to put the furnace and water heater in a closet under the stairs without a fire separation around them.
The fire department access route to our new building is longer than allowed; can we add hydrants instead?
The gas fireplace goes on an exterior wall that is 1 m from the property line; can the wall keep the same unprotected openings?
We're building a house on a rural acreage with a septic system; the question is the footing depth on clay soil.
Hot water heating pipes run through the floor, and we want to notch the joists deeper than the code allows.
We want the fire alarm system in our new four-storey apartment building to be single-stage instead of two-stage.
For the exit stairs of our new office we'd like emergency lighting battery packs at every other landing only.
The bathroom exhaust fans in our new house would vent into the attic instead of to the outdoors.
We'd like the exit path from the back of our new warehouse to pass through the electrical room.
The plumbing fixtures are fine; our question is the guard height on the deck of our house.
